title: Stop dispatch prepare handing a cell to the read-only gather agent
action: bee dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind cell emits subagent_type bee-gather - the agent whose own definition is Read, Grep, Glob and never writes. It is the same defect the model guard carried until the execution-agent lane: the generation tier now has TWO rendered agents, bee-build for a cell execution and bee-gather for a read-only gather, and the payload builder still knows only the old single mapping. A --kind cell dispatch must name bee-build; gather, reviewer and advisor keep the agent they name today. Red-first: pin the payload for each kind.

truths: the economics record still names the generation tier
